_about: vigia.py relay (anyone; gas keys only, no authority). Same shape as the signer config; only these keys are read for relaying. `db` is required: `signatario.py combine` opens it. `l2_pins` is required on chain 700770: `signatario.py combine` refuses without it (agent 112, finding 1). Round 17, OP Mainnet: one relayer per network, with its own gas keys, nonce record and files.

feed._about: docs/SIG-TRANSPORT.md. A relayer only reads: no publish_dir.

_about_relayer_keys: Encrypted keystores, mode 0600, owned by the relayer user; passwords through systemd LoadCredential= (deploy/signatario/bloch-busdc-op-mainnet-relay.service). vigia.py refuses raw hex relayer keys on chains 700770 and 1, because cast would carry them in argv (agent 174, fixed by agent 200).
_about_gas_ceilings: eth_max_gas_price_gwei 0.5: fee schedule of 2026-11-17 (coordinator). The relayer pays twice the node's eth_gasPrice quote, at most this; while the quote is above it nothing is sent, gas-price-ceiling is alerted and a release WAITS until the price is back under the ceiling (it is not lost). l2_max_gas_price_gwei is the default, not a decision.
_about_relay_role: One primary relayer; the other six operators run backups, each with its own gas keys and nonce record, staggered by relay_backup_index (F229-10, agent 241). vigia.py refuses to relay on chain 700770 until relay_role is "primary" or "backup". relay_other_gas_addresses lists the other relayers' L2 and Ethereum gas addresses; a relayer on one of them refuses to start.
relay_role: TBD-owner ("primary" on one operator, "backup" on the six others)
relay_backup_index: TBD-owner (backups only: 1 to 6, distinct per operator)
relay_other_gas_addresses: TBD-owner (the other six relayers' l2 and eth gas addresses)
_about_scan_state: Persisted log cursors and the finalized finished-item record (F229-11, agent 241). Default <shared_dir>/.scan; a changed hash at the cursor rescans.
_about_pacing: Run `vigia.py relay` without --interval (the network's 20 s is the default; a longer one is refused): a certificate must land within 256 blocks of its anchor.
